name: Iron-Club Charge

card.plain: Charge forward club first, shrugging off one hit.
card.frames: 12 / 6 / 14 frames, 110 damage, charges forward 240 units, 1-hit armour

card.plain: Lv 1 → Lv 2: the charge shrugs off two hits instead of one.
card.frames: Lv 1 → Lv 2: armour hits 1 → 2 (12 / 6 / 14 frames unchanged)

2.notes: Proposed (open question, A4). Changes how you fight: the Oni can walk a charge through a two-hit string or a hit plus a projectile instead of losing it to the second. The armour window stays 5-18 and only the hit count rises, so no clip or retime change (F2). Distinct from the Lv 3 evolution (wall bounce, A5). Alternative if the designer prefers the E21 style: recovery -4 (14 -> 10; the clip tail is a held last pose, so the trim would not need to change). Interaction to decide: Oni's Hide sets armour to frames 1-5, hits 1, so on this move it would replace this window instead of adding to it.

card.plain: The charge crushes the foe against the wall and bounces them back.
card.frames: 12 / 6 / 14 frames, 110 damage, wall bounce on hit

notes: Clip oni-iron-club-charge (GREYBOX reuse of preset 654, the 14-frame clean half stride, retimed to 32 frames, hit window 13-18; route A on YOK-219, designer 2026-11-01): 12/6/14. Delta against the rules.md first pass 16/6/24: -4 startup, same active, -10 recovery. The clip cannot reach 46 frames (14 ticks at 0.5x plus holds is at most about 33), so the clip is kept as truth (F2) and the total is limited to 32; the rules.md row changes by amendment AM24 in the same PR. Forward travel 240 units over the 6 active frames (40 units per tick, YOK-221: it stops at the opponent's push box and never pushes); the clip is in place (strip-root), so the rush distance is move data and the feet slide at 40 units per tick against the take's 9 units per tick at 0.5x, a greybox cost the real take replaces. 1-hit armour from frame 5 (the drive) to the end of active, frames 1-4 are the readable lean; the window is a proposal, rules.md gives none. Hitbox is the shoulder and club in front of the body, x 60-230 y 40-320, estimated, not re-placed from the posed rig; the leaning upper body is a second hurtbox on frames 5-24. Damage 110 is the table; hitstun 26, blockstun 18, strength heavy are placeholders. Slot C (214 / back, the classic charge direction): a proposal, rules.md names no slot for Oni's specials. A and B hold Ryo's starters, so a drafted common goes in C like Foxfire (drafting it onto Foxfire replaces it, A6, P3); Quake is D, so the Oni's own two specials never share a slot. EX (C5, E16) is a first pass: +30% damage and +120 units of travel. Lv 2 and Lv 3 text and presets are proposed; the wall_bounce key is read by the fight code (YOK-226, Match.Reaction.cs): Crushing Charge launches the defender off the stage corner. Preset ids are references for Asset Smith, no preset file written.
